name: Gath
overview: Gath was one of the principal cities of the Philistines, known as the home of Goliath and inhabited by the Gittites. Scripture records David fleeing to King Achish of Gath for refuge, where he feared for his life and even pretended madness to escape danger. This city was significant both as a stronghold of the Philistines and a place intertwined with key biblical figures and events.
